scope: NOR firmware maintenance, not camera/SD data. Root owned hardware; archive assembled offline.

part.datasheet: MX25UM51245G PM2183 v1.6, section 9-1 and Figures 17/18

interpretation.policy: Two separately authorized guarded writes with original helper failed, each followed by fresh INFO and exact partial NOR read. A separately built/reviewed v2 helper then performed one guarded write from the second exact partial state to revised v62b firmware. No automatic retry or controller guard relaxation.
interpretation.readback_scope: V2 helper final full NOR read was uploaded from RAM and compared byte-for-byte by the host; following 4 KiB guard was read independently with the frozen read-only helper.
interpretation.old_status_limit: Original result16 follows RDSCUR and checks the cached WIP-clear status byte; cleanup overwrites that byte, so final NOR status/security zero are not the triggering observation.
interpretation.successful_run_limit: Zero WIP-clear/WEL-pending observations in the successful v2 run; success qualifies this run but does not prove the former failure mechanism or immunity to recurrence.
interpretation.owner_attestation: Root reports no reset or power interruption during failed-write diagnosis and repairs.

excluded: No camera frames, PNG pixels, SD file buffers, raw instruments, process inventories or unrelated files.
